objects.name: Analytic 2292
objects.description: An analyst observes a user-originated instruction submitted to an AI application that attempts to override protected instructions or operational constraints. Within the same authenticated interaction, the AI system subsequently attempts a tool invocation, resource access, or workflow transition inconsistent with the authorized task or capability scope. The analyst correlates the originating instruction, subsequent operation, and authorization context to identify a potential successful instruction-boundary violation.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Instructions and operational constraints that user-originated input cannot supersede
Permitted task sequences and workflow transitions
Authorized tools, operations, resources, and actions for each actor or agent role
Maximum interval between the submitted instruction and subsequent operation
Required actor, session, interaction, or trace identifiers linking the observations
Evidence required to classify an instruction as an attempted authority override
Approved testing identities and execution contexts
